name: settingsKit
description: Saved variables for World of Warcraft addons: scoped databases with schema-validated writes, defaults that are never written back, profiles and versioned migrations.
summary: Saved variables with scopes, schema-validated writes, defaults never written back, profiles and versioned migrations.

Namespaces.description: db:RegisterNamespace and db:GetNamespace: child databases with their own schema over the saved variable's namespaces section, in AceDB's layout, following the parent's profile.

Defaults.description: SettingsKit:Open and db:RegisterNamespace from plain AceDB-style defaults: the write rules inferred from each default, checked without SchemaKit.

SpecProfiles.description: Profiles assigned per specialization or talent group: SettingsKit:GetSpecIndex, db:SetSpecProfile, db:GetSpecProfile and db:ApplySpecProfile, switched by itself on spec changes while EventKit is embedded.
